alert: Error rate elevated on frontend product pages

root_cause.summary: The product-catalog service is running out of memory, leading to errors that surface as elevated error rates on frontend product pages. The container health metrics show memory usage at 93% of its limit, and traces confirm the failure originates in product-catalog GetProduct calls. Restarting the container will clear the memory pressure and restore normal operation.

evidence.why_it_matters: Deepest failing span is product-catalog GetProduct, indicating the service itself is failing.
Container health shows MEMORY_HIGH (93% of limit) and memory trend +15 points, indicating resource exhaustion.

proposed_action.reason: Product-catalog container is consuming excessive memory, causing request failures to propagate to frontend product pages.
